coverage.promise: Nonlinear equations and ordinary variable-Jacobian Newton
coverage.boundary: The frozen-Jacobian contraction item does not prove ordinary Newton convergence. The new theorem is only local for C3 F, invertible derivative near the root, and sufficiently close start.

coverage.promise: Runge–Kutta order/stability functions, multistep zero-stability and Dahlquist equivalence
coverage.boundary: Multistep root condition is distinct from one-step stability; repeated interior roots are allowed and repeated unit roots are not. Variable-step convergence is not included.

coverage.promise: Stiff stability regions and adaptive ODE estimation
coverage.boundary: A/L stability are scalar test-equation contracts. Embedded estimates are not certified global error bounds; fixed-step P-NUM-ODE-02 does not certify adaptive meshes.

coverage.promise: Linear and nonlinear BVP solvers
coverage.boundary: The linear row proves one fixed 1D Dirichlet model with boundary consistency and uniform inverse control. Nonlinear shooting/collocation carries IVP, Jacobian and discretization errors separately.

coverage.promise: Geometric integration
coverage.boundary: The time-dependent Hamiltonian supplier retains its stated AC_omega premise. Formal modified series must be truncated for finite-order estimates.

fd-fv.packet_status: research complete; Süli note was read in full; source-limited Trefethen and nonlinear-FV proof boundaries retained

coverage.promise: Linear consistency, stability, convergence and Lax–Richtmyer equivalence
coverage.boundary: Trefethen gives the theorem contract but marks proof and essential rigor unwritten. Supply a local common-Banach-space proof and mesh embedding/norm comparison.

coverage.promise: Elliptic finite differences
coverage.boundary: Boundary closure, discrete summation by parts, and a mesh-uniform inverse/maximum-principle bound are mandatory.

coverage.promise: Parabolic finite differences
coverage.boundary: Fourier stability on periodic/infinite grids does not prove finite-boundary or nonnormal stability; L2 stability does not imply a discrete maximum principle.

coverage.promise: Hyperbolic finite differences, energy and CFL
coverage.boundary: Derive scheme-specific energy/Fourier estimates and include inflow boundary data. CFL alone is not a universal sufficiency theorem.

coverage.promise: Conservative finite-volume weak limits and scalar entropy convergence
coverage.boundary: NA-26 assumes strong L1loc convergence and proves only the weak equation. NA-27 separately supplies monotonicity, discrete entropy, local Helly/BV compactness, CFL, and Kruzhkov uniqueness; global L1 requires tail control. No systems theorem is claimed.

coverage.boundary: State affine mesh, shape regularity, conformity, reference functional and Sobolev embedding hypotheses.

coverage.boundary: L2 gain is limited by adjoint regularity; local H2 results require their C2-domain/coefficient hypotheses. Quadrature replaces exact Galerkin orthogonality with a defect.

coverage.boundary: CR normal traces need r>1/2 in the cited theorem; Nitsche penalty must exceed the inverse-trace threshold; DG penalty and L2 claims require their stated coercivity/adjoint assumptions.

coverage.boundary: Reliability, local efficiency, oscillation, mesh closure, contraction, and complexity have separate assumptions. General coefficient-dependent complexity proof was deferred by the read source.

coverage.boundary: Continuous semigroup suppliers do not supply the evolution-triple variational theorem or FEM/Ritz/time-discretization error.

coverage.boundary: Conforming symmetric min–max is distinct from nonnormal/nonconforming compact-operator perturbation; multiple eigenvalues require eigenspace comparisons.

coverage.boundary: Gaussian root, positivity and remainder proofs are local obligations. Adaptive indicators do not certify error without a-posteriori remainder, stability, regularity, and controlled arithmetic.

coverage.promise: IID Monte Carlo, deterministic QMC, RQMC and MLMC
coverage.boundary: CLT is reused from Probability. Koksma–Hlawka and nested-scramble variance need local proofs because the read Owen chapters cite them. Giles proves only abstract rate-to-cost implications; adaptive stopping remains heuristic.

coverage.boundary: These are independent planned pre-category pages in plan-machine-learning-track.md and must not be duplicated. Carry AC and standing hypothesis (H) for the imported Itô integral/isometry/multidimensional Itô suppliers. The exact time-Hölder modulus norm/constants in P-NUM-SDE-01 remain a final-theorem specification gap. The finite-L2 time-dependent route is distinct from the autonomous all-moment Higham–Mao–Stuart strong theorem.
